reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE)
), compared AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025, with the month before
  SELECT month, spend_eur, LAG(spend_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_spend_eur
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month, spend_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (spend_eur - prev_spend_eur) / prev_spend_eur, 1) AS change_pct
FROM compared

  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT m.month, m.spend_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (m.spend_eur - p.spend_eur) / p.spend_eur, 1) AS change_pct
FROM monthly m
LEFT JOIN monthly p ON p.month = m.month - INTERVAL 1 MONTH

solver.query:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1
), c AS (
  SELECT month, spend_eur, LAG(spend_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev
  FROM m
)
SELECT month, spend_eur, ROUND(100.0 * (spend_eur - prev) / prev, 1) AS change_pct
FROM c
